checklist.notes: A timeline, three-fact mediation, a bounded staff request, and information stress scaffold narration and practical help. This directly supports: handle narration, mediation, and socially suitable requests; combine selected A2.1 capabilities for a communicative purpose.
Models and controlled noticing precede retrieval, recording, self-checking, or freer production, so the lesson is usable for guided self-study.

The sequence (An action around a past time, Tell your friend three facts, Use one request model, Stress MA in information) moves from supported input to application while respecting the stated prerequisite context.
Roles, examples, expected facts or forms, and checking actions are concrete enough to act on; the local improvement below is non-blocking.
Four bounded sections fit the declared 35-minute lesson, with cueing or models before the most demanding task.
Reading, writing, speaking, recording/replay, and pronunciation actions each serve a declared lesson dimension rather than being decorative.
Practical contexts, Vietnamese names where used, and explicit sound/stress guidance are accessible to Vietnamese learners without claiming a universal L1 deficit.

findings.description: The final integrated turn combines background, request, and mediated facts without a short cue sequence.
findings.recommendation: Add a cue sequence—background, request, relayed facts—without giving a full answer.

limitations: Review covers only the immutable lesson and fresh static machine report; it does not establish learner outcomes, human review, release approval, provider authentication, or live delivery quality.
